actions.script:
import java.time.LocalDate
def now = LocalDate.now() def fysSetting = ec.entity.find("zenith.erp.base.CompanySettings").condition("organizationPartyId", ec.user.getPreference("ACTIVE_ORGANIZATION")).condition("settingKey", "FY_START_MONTH").one() int fyStartMonth = fysSetting ? (fysSetting.settingValue as int) : 4 int fyStart = now.monthValue >= fyStartMonth ? now.year : now.year - 1 String fySuffix = String.format("%02d-%02d", fyStart % 100, (fyStart + 1) % 100)
def lastNc = ec.entity.find("zenith.erp.quality.NonConformance") .condition("ncNumber", "like", "NC/${fySuffix}/%").orderBy("-ncNumber").limit(1).list() int nextSeq = 1 if (lastNc) { def parts = lastNc[0].ncNumber.split("/") if (parts.length == 3) nextSeq = (parts[2] as int) + 1 } String ncNumber = "NC/${fySuffix}/" + String.format("%05d", nextSeq)
context.ncId = ec.entity.sequencedIdPrimary("zenith.erp.quality.NonConformance", null, null) ec.entity.makeValue("zenith.erp.quality.NonConformance").setAll([ ncId: context.ncId, ncNumber: ncNumber, inspectionId: inspectionId, productId: productId, batchNumber: batchNumber, ncType: ncType, severity: severity, description: description, statusId: "NcOpen", reportedDate: ec.user.nowTimestamp, reportedByPartyId: ec.user.userId, assignedToPartyId: assignedToPartyId, dueDate: dueDate, dispositionAction: dispositionAction, affectedQuantity: affectedQuantity ]).create()

def existing = ec.entity.find("zenith.erp.quality.InspectionTemplateParam") .condition("templateId", templateId).orderBy("-parameterSeqId").limit(1).list() int nextSeq = 1 if (existing) nextSeq = (existing[0].parameterSeqId as int) + 1
ec.entity.makeValue("zenith.erp.quality.InspectionTemplateParam").setAll([ templateId: templateId, parameterSeqId: String.format("%05d", nextSeq), parameterId: parameterId, sequenceNum: nextSeq, isMandatory: isMandatory ]).create()
